HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS new paragraph This is a 73 year old gentleman with a heart attack in June 2061 treated medically and a recent angiogram showing three vessel disease who presents for elective bypass period. He was seen in clinic 7/24, 7/27 by phone and 7/31. Pre op he was on play licks, Zocor, Toprol, and lisinopril which was held. Nephrology saw him 08/10 and felt the kidney function is chronic, baseline eGFR around 10, no dialysis need.
PROCEDURES 08/14: Pulmonary artery catheter (Swan Ganz) placed in OR holding. 08/15: Median stern at me, cannulation, cardiopulmonary bypass, cross clamp on, cardioplegia, LIMA to LAD, vein graft to OM and to RCA, cross clamp off, chest closed. Anesthesia: midazolam, propofol, rocuronium, remifentanil, isoflurane; cefazolin 2 g prophylaxis; heparin then protamine. Case number OR-62-08147. Chest x-ray post op: lines ok, no pneumothorax.
HOSPITAL COURSE: Extubated POD 0 evening, chest tubes out POD 2, pacing wires out POD 4. Troponin down trending. WBC 4.0 on 08/15 then 7.9; hemoglobin 12.2 then 12.7, stable, no transfusion. Creatinine stayed 2.9, eGFR 9.3 then 10.8, K normal. No AF. Ambulating the hall with PT. Mr. Marsh was visited by wife Corinne and daughter Lila daily, brother in law Ray brought a card. Lipid panel pre op LDL 79.2, total 168.9.
